note: Groups AI4 tool calls by what they do to the work, for the chat archive (afield.chatlog). Names are as aiChatToolName gives them: no 24-hex wire suffix, no trailing 'Request'. A pattern ending in '*' matches a prefix. The first family that matches wins, so list narrower families first. Entries starting _field_ are box-authored tools (aiTool{}); the house-sketch kit's are listed because its chats are the first corpus. 'count' gives the nouns a chat-panel round summary uses ('2 notes'); families without it are not counted there.

families.name: notes
families.label: Notes and playbook
families.purpose: The agent writes down what it decided or learned: document guides, geometry findings and their replies, its scratchpad and checklist.

families.name: recipes
families.label: Recipes and search
families.purpose: The machine itself changes: recipe and routing-search candidates are proposed, tested against fixtures, applied or rebaselined.

families.name: design
families.label: Design edits
families.purpose: The thing being made changes: sketch and services edits, box properties, files, new boxes.

families.name: builds
families.label: Builds and stabilization
families.purpose: Long-running work is started, waited on and inspected until it settles.

families.name: looking
families.label: Looking
families.purpose: The agent looks at pictures of its work: box output and geometry views, attachments.

families.name: reading
families.label: Reading
families.purpose: The agent reads notes, state, properties and code without changing them.

families.name: computing
families.label: Computing
families.purpose: The agent runs code or asks a box-authored tool to work something out.

families.name: tooling
families.label: Tool loading
families.purpose: The agent discovers or loads tools.
